digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and rotation tracking
propositions: last_get_pass advances up to 20 binding entries per pass even when no real binding changes occur.

A rotation state sidecar file (.bridge_state/get_rotation.json) must be introduced and dual-written with the legacy inline field during rollout to enable safe migration without breaking interleaved old and new binaries.
After rotation state initialization, an idempotent pass with no absent-key GETs must leave all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and not advance HEAD.
A pass with absent-key GETs must advance the same selected Jira-key stamps in both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, and both files must be staged and committed together without git add -A.
Legacy bindings stores containing only inline stamps must preserve rotation order and materialize equivalent sidecar state on next persisted save.
The outbound_differ.py module must remain at or below 800 lines after extracting wrappers and wiring rotation accessors.
